welcome.title: Welcome to Task on Demand
welcome.content: A platform for finding and completing local tasks in your area. Create tasks or find work near you.

localTasks.title: Local Tasks
localTasks.content: Tasks are shown within 1 km of your location. This ensures you only see relevant tasks nearby.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.content: Task address is hidden until you claim it. This protects the customer's privacy until confirmation.

payment.title: Payment
payment.content: Payment happens outside the app. Customer and executor agree on payment method independently after task confirmation.

rules.title: Important Rules
rules.content: Only one user can claim a task. Frequent cancellations (more than 3 per 24 hours) may lead to temporary blocking from claiming new tasks for 24 hours.
